title: Armour Sets
summary: Hypixel's 834 armour pieces: how stats work when worn, what shows on the tooltip, reforges and potato books, the Wardrobe, and what is not built yet.

s.x: All of Hypixel SkyBlock's armour is in the game:
, with Hypixel's names, rarities and stats. With FurfSky Reborn installed, each piece looks the way it does on Hypixel. This page explains how armour works today. The full list is in
, and every piece has its own page.

rows.x: 10 Strength, 2 Crit Chance, 10 Crit Damage, 150 Health, 190 Defense, 3 Speed, 25 Intelligence

s.x: Armour counts in its own slot.
A helmet held in your hand gives nothing. Wear a piece on the head, chest, legs or feet to get its stats.

Health, Defense, Strength, Crit Chance, Crit Damage, Speed, Intelligence, Magic Find and every other stat on a worn piece goes into your totals (a few, such as Ferocity, have no effect yet), along with your skills, slayer levels and SkyBlock Level. Open
in the menu to see where each point comes from.
Defense replaces them: damage you take is multiplied by
SkyBlock armour is always unbreakable, so it needs no repairs.
Heads show their own skin and leather armour keeps its colour. FurfSky Reborn gives the rest their Hypixel textures. See
The tooltip is Hypixel's: the stats in Hypixel's order, the lore, and the rarity line in bold, such as

Hypixel's set bonuses and full-set abilities (Strong Blood, Superior Blood, Protective Blood and the rest) are not in the game yet. Hypixel's item data has stats and a little lore but no set or ability text, so wearing every piece of a set gives you the pieces' stats and nothing more. They arrive as their own systems are built.
Other things some pieces list on Hypixel, such as dungeon stars, gemstone slots and the requirements for dungeon armour, are in the data but do nothing yet.
